text:
Jordan: posted a pic of the world's brightest ceiling lamp reflecting on my monitor + Luna the cat curled on my keyboard. meeting-ready? :flushed: :cat:
InfraBot: uploaded 1 file
Nina: lol Luna deserves speaker privileges. For the glare: matte screen protector helps a ton. also try tilting the monitor down 5-10 degrees so the reflection misses the camera.
Jordan: I can't tilt much, desk is wedged in under the window. 
Omar: polarizing film on the monitor or a small linear polarizer in front of the webcam. you can also hang a lightweight blackout curtain over the top of the window for meetings.
Jordan: polarizer sounds fancy, where do I get one quickly?
Priya: Amazon has cheap CPL filters for webcams and phone lenses. DIY: laminate two sunglasses lenses together (opposite polarization) till you find the dark spot then trim.
Eli: quick software hack if the webcam is being weird: on mac `sudo killall VDCAssistant` to restart camera drivers. sometimes resetting exposure fixes the glare.
Jordan: tried the killall trick, camera reset but glare stayed. also Luna walked across the keyboard and typed a string of semicolons mid-standup :joy:
Nina: poll: Has a pet ever typed during a meeting? react :cat: = yes, :raised_hand: = once, :no_entry_sign: = never
Omar: :cat:
Priya: :raised_hand:
Eli: :cat:
Jordan: posting an "after" pic in 10 mins if the curtain trick works. Luna demands a cameo credit.
